items.name: Fireball scroll
items.description:
A scroll that describes the methods of casting a fireball spell. Watch your fingers.

<color=#F1C40F> Allows the user to cast a fireball. Does a lot of damage. </color>

items.name: Wooden crossbow
items.description: A crossbow is a ranged weapon using an elastic launching device consisting of a bow-like assembly called a prod, mounted horizontally on a main frame called a tiller, which is hand-held in a similar fashion to the stock of a long gun. Crossbows shoot arrow-like projectiles called bolts or quarrels. A person who shoots crossbow is called a crossbowman, an arbalister or an arbalist

items.name: A scrawled note
items.description:
Hauled in a mighty fine catch this time. Seven women and ten men, each healthy and strong. Top-quality goods. Captain doesn't know yet where we'll sell them, but for merchandise like this, we're sure to get a good price anywhere. Perhaps we'll sail to Sarokos.

There's this one we've got who's damned pretty - but a damned pain the arse, too. If not for that, I'd keep her for myself. But when she's not bawling her eyes out, she's yelling threats at us. Demands we let her go or drop her off at Brava's temple. And that if we don't, her brother will sail after her and slaughter us all. 

First three days at sea were quiet, but now a storm's blowing in. Blasted weather. 

<color=#F1C40F> The rest of the text is unrecognizable. </color>
